label_judgement_standard: actionable requires ALL THREE: (1) need category is explicit - naming the CATEGORY is enough, a specific product name is not required; (2) the current approach is unmet and the author is actively seeking a solution - complaining about it plus asking, or actively asking for recommendations / alternatives / how to choose; (3) it is the author's own decision - they hold or share the decision. Watching the market, researching for someone else, promoting their own product, or hunting for content ideas does NOT count. Missing any one of the three -> borderline; clearly unrelated -> not_actionable. Ground truth is PER-TESTSET: consistency constraints apply only within one testset, never across testsets, because each testset has a different buyer.
